section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains the respective advantages of snow and wool, and how the verse "He gives snow like wool" means both virtues will be combined.
section.t: And 4)
And this is "He gives snow like wool,"
for in each of them there is an advantage.
The advantage of snow is that the correction and filling of defects through the thirteen tikkunei d'ikna
(snow)
is in inwardness
(in the configuration of the revealed powers),
but it is within measure and limitation,
for since it is in the manner of action
[that the essence belonging to the revealed powers acts within them]
there are several levels of distinction in this.
And the advantage of wool is,
that the correction of defects through the hair of the head is that it is revealed in them that in their inwardness
(from the perspective of their essence)
it is not applicable at all that there should be a defect in them.
And the meaning of "He gives snow like wool,"
that also in snow the aspect of wool will be drawn,
is—that there will be both virtues.
That is,
that this, that from the perspective of the essence no defect is applicable in them,
will also affect their configuration.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the union of wool and snow requires a drawing from a place higher than both, revealing the soul's root in Atzmus where its simplicity and powers are one.
section.t: And in order for the connection of wool and snow to be, it is through a drawing from a place higher than both
[as brought above
(section 8)
of the maamar].
And one can explain the elucidation of this,
that this, that the essence of the soul and the configuration of the powers are
(analogous to)
two matters,
is because even the essence of the soul is defined within a category,
and its category is above the configuration of the powers.
But from the perspective of the essence of the soul as it is rooted in Atzmus,
the simplicity of the soul and the configuration of intellect and emotions within it are all one.
And through the revelation of this aspect of the soul,
also the powers of the soul
(the configuration of the powers)
are in a manner that it is not applicable that they should be contrary to the intention.
And through the drawing of the essence of the soul
(wool)
into the particular powers
(snow)
an elevation is also made in the essence of the soul,
for through this its root is revealed in it as it is rooted in Atzmus.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section connects the concept of "He gives snow like wool" to "for He strengthens the bars of your gates," explaining that wool and snow correspond to makif and pnimi, and their union draws the makif into the pnimi.
section.t: And based on this, one can explain the connection of the matter of "He gives snow like wool" to the matter of "for He strengthens the bars of your gates,"
for wool and snow are analogous to makif and pnimi.
And through the union of wool and snow,
that the essence of the soul which is above the revealed powers
(wool,
makif)
is drawn into the revealed powers
(snow,
pnimi),
through this it is done likewise in the revelations above,
that also the makifim are drawn into the pnimiut.
